mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the retinas to the focusing parts made the path of light through the eye understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the corneas, lenses and irises was clear, but the three consecutive slotting actions felt a little repetitive.

surprise.text: The lens views showed that flatter and rounder shapes bend light by different amounts.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and named slots made the fittings understandable.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see another body system come together, although I would hope for more choices than consecutive obvious fittings.
